title: The artifact gate's Bash branch asks the door where a redirect lands
intention: bin/cmd/artifactgate's Bash branch resolves each redirect target against the command's effective directory (a leading `cd <dir> &&`, else the hook's cwd) and refuses only when cairn.tools.artifact door.locate() of that absolute path is a record — the same question the Edit/Write branch asks; a write verb with no redirect keeps today's text rule.
why: Akien 2026-10-10: "to the best of your ability, get it all closed", pre-approved through PROVED. This ticket closes live trouble /home/akien/dev/src/CairnCommons/troubles/artifactgate-reads-a-worktree-copy-as-a-record.json, a measured fault that enters as a bug (skills/intent/SKILL.md: a bug enters as a ticket, not through /intent). Measured 2026-10-08 (builder scratchpad gate_probe.py): `cd /tmp/claude-1000/bare.AbCd && git show 9edee02e:cairn/machines/rehearsal/intention+why.json > cairn/machines/rehearsal/intention+why.json` -> REFUSED by the Bash branch; door.locate on the absolute path -> None.
traces_to: Law 4 (one gate, one answer per path); Law 1 (voyage_craft clause 4.4 runs as typed).
how: bin/cmd/artifactgate verdict() (:91-110): extract redirect targets (the existing _redirect_re group, widened to capture any path after > / >>); compute base = the dir of a leading `cd X &&|;` clause if present else tool_input cwd / os.getcwd(); abs = (base / target).resolve() unless target is absolute or ~-prefixed (expand); refuse iff door.locate(abs) is not None. Keep the WRITE_VERBS branch untouched.
falsifier: bin/proofs/test_artifact_gate.py gains teeth under PROVES {'a55a82b351c6': {'1','2'}}: (1) the measured worktree command (cd /tmp/<scratch> && ... > cairn/machines/rehearsal/intention+why.json) is ALLOWED; (2) `> cairn/machines/rehearsal/intention+why.json` run from the repo root, and `cd ~/dev/src/cairn && ... > cairn/.../intention+why.json`, are still REFUSED. Existing teeth stay green. Hollow: reverting to the root-relative regex reds 1.

decisions.text: Only a leading cd clause is honoured; anything subtler (pushd, subshells) falls back to the hook cwd, which errs toward the current behaviour. CC's call, per Akien 2026-10-09

artifactgate: verdict(tool_name, tool_input) keeps its signature; base = the dir of a leading ^\s*cd\s+(\S+)\s*(?:&&|;) clause (quotes stripped, expanduser + expandvars) when present, else tool_input.get('cwd'), else os.getcwd(); _main copies the payload's top-level cwd into tool_input['cwd'] when tool_input carries none. A relative base resolves against the cwd. CC's call, per Akien 2026-10-09

Redirect targets are every match of (?<![<0-9&])>>?\s*(?!&)['"]?([^\s'";&|)<>]+) in the command (2>&1 and >&2 are not targets); each target is expanduser+expandvars'd, joined to base unless absolute, resolved, and the Bash branch refuses iff door.locate(str(abs)) is not None for any target. _redirect_re and its text rule are removed from the Bash branch; the WRITE_VERBS co-occurrence branch and DOOR_FORMS are unchanged. CC's call, per Akien 2026-10-09

bin/proofs/test_artifact_gate.py gained PROVES 'a55a82b351c6' {'1','2'}: (1) cd <tmp> && git show ... > cairn/machines/rehearsal/intention+why.json is allowed, and the hook with payload cwd=<tmp> exits 0; (2) the same redirect from the repo root, after cd ~/<repo>, after cd <abs repo>;, and to the absolute record path stay refused. The standing refused Bash list is handed cwd=_REPO_ROOT. Tooth 1 red-first 2026-10-11. CC's call, per Akien 2026-10-09
